**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Terminate the entire probe process group on timeout**

If the packaged `opencode` launcher forks a child, `subprocess.run(..., timeout=10)` kills and reaps only the launcher, allowing its descendant to remain alive after this adapter exits 124 and records a completed timeout. The same problem affects the 600-second diagnostic call, and the regression misses it because its fake sleeps directly; start each probe in an isolated process group and terminate that group on timeout.
